mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 3% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% each in a month signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals easing monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% does not correlate with subsequent easing cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP (GDPC1) and Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 1% each in a quarter signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both increase > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.
